results.title: Widgeteer – AI Widget Builder for Forms & Bookings
results.content: Widgeteer is an AI tool that builds working website widgets from a single sentence of plain English. You describe what you need — the site's own examples are "a cleaning quote calculator" and "a table booking form" — and Widgeteer produces a working widget in seconds. The range covers forms, quizzes, booking tools and calculators, with the widget library also listing galleries and saying there is "plenty more". The product is positioned for busy owners of shops, blogs, agencies, clubs, clinics and side projects: people who, in the site's words, "do not have an afternoon to spend in a form builder". Its promise is summarised in the three words used across the homepage — say it, see it, sorted — with "no setup, no keys, no code" needed to get from an idea to an embedded widget. Traditional [...] to get from an idea to an embedded widget. Traditional form and widget builders assume you will spend time in a configuration interface: choosing field types, wiring up settings and figuring out where submissions go. Widgeteer frames that work as the product's job rather than the user's, under the heading "No tech. No config. No code." The site describes the target customer's constraint directly: "Whatever you run, you do not have an afternoon to spend in a form builder. Say what you need and get on with your day." It also addresses the common frustration that a generated widget can be close but not quite right, noting that "your widget is never stuck the way it came out" — you can fix a word yourself or ask for something bigger. Booking and enquiry widgets are a major part of what [...] proposition is that a working, editable, embeddable widget should be one sentence away. Describe the form, quiz, booking tool or calculator you need, adjust it by hand or by asking, test it in a live preview, then embed it on WordPress, Shopify or any other site with submissions routed to email, Zapier, n8n, Make or a webhook — no code, no keys, no setup screens.

## Description

Widgeteer is your agent marketeer and engineer. It doesn’t just create crisp marketing material such as FAQs and before-and-after sliders, it also builds fully working forms. Receive an instant email on every submission, or pass submissions on to Zapier, n8n and more. Countdown timer? Product feedback form? Product recommendation quiz? It does all that and more. [...] How it works

1. Install and activate the plugin, then open Widgeteer in your dashboard menu.
2. Enter your email address. We send you a one-time code, so there is no password to remember.
3. Describe the widget you want, or pick an idea from the prompt library, and press Generate.
4. Want a change? Tell Widgeteer what to change, such as “add a phone number field”, and it updates the widget for you.
5. Add it to any page with the Widgeteer AI Widget block, or paste its shortcode.
6. Choose what happens when someone submits: an email to you, or a hand-off to Zapier, n8n and other tools.
